blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas missed out on a bronze medal in the men’s U-23 3×3 basketball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after falling to Iran, 21-10, on Friday. Hopes of a podium finish dwindled after Iran took command in the first three minutes, leaving Gilas to play catch-up in the match held at Kinjo Futo Station Square. The team of Nic Cabanero, Luis Pablo, Koji Buenaflor and Doy Dungo struggled to hit its outside shots during attempts to cut down on the Iran lead to eventually settle with a […]...
